text:
mira: Sales asks for a short 'assimilation buffer' for Dedicated onboardings — 3 flavors they want: pilot(24h), ramp(7d), assimilation(30d). Thoughts?
ajay: define guarantee: hard reserve vs priority bucket. Hard reserve needs lead time.
sam: recommend configs mapped to profiles and fallback ordering: cache prewarm -> variant fallback -> regional spill -> shed noncritical -> queue.
kaori: infra: for MVP we should implement tenant-specific autoscale profile and an optional hard_headroom_gpus field. API must validate against region capacity.
leah: sales: customers want simple contract language and non-rollover for burst credits. checkbox: "Guaranteed launch capacity (paid)".
ops-oncall: ops needs a manual approval path for MVP + a prewarm runbook. Automation later. Estimate 2 sprints for dashboards.
billing-bot: billing mapping: hard_headroom -> reserved SKU billed pro-rata; soft bursts -> metered with caps. Unused soft credits expire at 30d.
mira: action items: draft customer wording (mira), runbook (ops), schema PR (kaori), contract text (leah). Sync Tue 11am. End of thread.
